phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Nuancing and solving
goal: Rephrase, nuance and solve an unexpected problem.

model.note: "sicuro" for a man, "sicura" for a woman.

variants.native: I mean, I can't come tonight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Scusi, il treno delle nove per Milano è cancellato?
turns.phon: SKOO-zee, eel TREH-noh DEHL-leh NOH-veh pehr mee-LAH-noh eh kahn-chehl-LAH-toh
turns.native: Excuse me, is the nine o'clock train to Milan cancelled?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì, purtroppo. C'è uno sciopero.
turns.phon: SEE, poor-TROHP-poh. cheh OO-noh SHOH-peh-roh
turns.native: Yes, unfortunately. There's a strike.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: C'è un problema: ho una riunione alle undici. Cosa possiamo fare?
turns.phon: cheh oon proh-BLEH-mah: oh OO-nah ryoo-NYOH-neh AHL-leh OON-dee-chee. KOH-zah pohs-SYAH-moh FAH-reh
turns.native: There's a problem: I have a meeting at eleven. What can we do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Può prendere il regionale delle nove e venti, ma arriva alle undici e mezza.
turns.phon: pwoh PREHN-deh-reh eel reh-joh-NAH-leh DEHL-leh NOH-veh eh VEHN-tee, mah ar-REE-vah AHL-leh OON-dee-chee eh MEHD-dzah
turns.native: You can take the 9:20 regional train, but it gets in at half past eleven.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Se ho capito bene, non c'è niente prima?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, nohn cheh NYEHN-teh PREE-mah
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, there's nothing earlier?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Non proprio. Forse c'è un autobus alle otto e mezza, ma non sono sicuro.
turns.phon: nohn PROH-pryoh. FOR-seh cheh oon OW-toh-boos AHL-leh OHT-toh eh MEHD-dzah, mah nohn SOH-noh see-KOO-roh
turns.native: Not really. Maybe there's a bus at half past eight, but I'm not sure.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Va bene, prendo il regionale. Posso cambiare il biglietto?
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh, PREHN-doh eel reh-joh-NAH-leh. POHS-soh kahm-BYAH-reh eel bee-LYEHT-toh
turns.native: All right, I'll take the regional. Can I change the ticket?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Certo, glielo cambio subito, senza supplemento.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh, LYEH-loh KAHM-byoh SOO-bee-toh, SEHN-tsah soop-pleh-MEHN-toh
turns.native: Of course, I'll change it for you right away, no supplement.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, dottore. Ho mal di gola e la febbre da ieri.
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, doht-TOH-reh. oh mahl dee GOH-lah eh lah FEHB-breh dah YEH-ree
turns.native: Good morning, doctor. I've had a sore throat and a fever since yesterday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Vediamo. Ha anche la tosse?
turns.phon: veh-DYAH-moh. ah AHN-keh lah TOHS-seh
turns.native: Let's see. Do you have a cough too?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Non proprio, solo un po' la sera.
turns.phon: nohn PROH-pryoh, SOH-loh oon poh lah SEH-rah
turns.native: Not really, just a little in the evening.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Può darsi che sia solo un'influenza.
turns.phon: pwoh DAR-see keh SEE-ah SOH-loh oo-neen-floo-EHN-tsah
turns.native: It may just be the flu.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Cioè, non è grave?
turns.phon: choh-EH, nohn eh GRAH-veh
turns.native: I mean, it's not serious?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: No. Riposo, molta acqua e queste compresse per cinque giorni.
turns.phon: noh. ree-POH-zoh, MOHL-tah AH-kwah eh KWEHS-teh kohm-PREHS-seh pehr CHEEN-kweh JOR-nee
turns.native: No. Rest, plenty of water and these tablets for five days.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Se ho capito bene, una compressa al giorno?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, OO-nah kohm-PREHS-sah ahl JOR-noh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, one tablet a day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Due: una la mattina e una la sera. Se non migliora, torni tra una settimana.
turns.phon: DOO-eh: OO-nah lah maht-TEE-nah eh OO-nah lah SEH-rah. seh nohn mee-LYOH-rah, TOR-nee trah OO-nah seht-tee-MAH-nah
turns.native: Two: one in the morning and one in the evening. If it doesn't improve, come back in a week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Grazie, dottore.
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh, doht-TOH-reh
turns.native: Thank you, doctor.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Marco, c'è un problema: il cliente dice che la consegna era per oggi.
turns.phon: MAR-koh, cheh oon proh-BLEH-mah: eel klee-EHN-teh DEE-cheh keh lah kohn-SEH-nyah EH-rah pehr OHD-jee
turns.native: Marco, there's a problem: the client says the delivery was for today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Come? Io avevo capito venerdì.
turns.phon: KOH-meh. EE-oh ah-VEH-voh kah-PEE-toh veh-nehr-DEE
turns.native: What? I'd understood Friday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Forse c'è stato un errore nella mail.
turns.phon: FOR-seh cheh STAH-toh oon ehr-ROH-reh NEHL-lah MAYL
turns.native: Maybe there was a mistake in the email.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Può darsi. Quello che voglio dire è che non è colpa nostra.
turns.phon: pwoh DAR-see. KWEHL-loh keh VOH-lyoh DEE-reh eh keh nohn eh KOHL-pah NOHS-trah
turns.native: Could be. What I mean is that it's not our fault.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: In parte sì, in parte no. Cosa possiamo fare?
turns.phon: een PAR-teh SEE, een PAR-teh noh. KOH-zah pohs-SYAH-moh FAH-reh
turns.native: Partly yes, partly no. What can we do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Possiamo consegnare una prima parte oggi e il resto venerdì.
turns.phon: pohs-SYAH-moh kohn-seh-NYAH-reh OO-nah PREE-mah PAR-teh OHD-jee eh eel REHS-toh veh-nehr-DEE
turns.native: We can deliver a first part today and the rest on Friday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Se ho capito bene, chiamo il cliente e gli propongo questo?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, KYAH-moh eel klee-EHN-teh eh lyee proh-POHN-goh KWEHS-toh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I call the client and suggest this?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Esatto. E ci scusiamo per il malinteso.
turns.phon: eh-ZAHT-toh. eh chee skoo-ZYAH-moh pehr eel mah-leen-TEH-zoh
turns.native: Exactly. And we apologise for the misunderstanding.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Rephrase (cioè, quello che voglio dire è…), hedge (piuttosto, non proprio, in parte), express uncertainty (forse, può darsi che) and handle a hitch by checking you've understood correctly.
